name: tw02-scan
js: const w = v.director.weather; const off = v.cloudUniforms.uCloudOffset.value; const [lat, lon] = v.ground.localFrame.toGeo(off.x, off.y); const ob = (v.state.heading + (v.state.seat === 'right' ? 90 : -90)) * Math.PI / 180; const out = []; const t0 = v.state.simTime; for (let d = 0; d < 62; d++) { for (const hh of [0, 2 * 3600e3]) { v.state.simTime = t0 + d * 864e5 + hh; const cells = w.farTowerCells(lat, lon) || []; let n = 0, nn = 0; for (const c of cells) { const [x, z] = v.ground.localFrame.toLocal(c.lat, c.lon); const dx = x - off.x, dz = z - off.y; const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dz); if (dist < 180 || dist > 480) continue; const b = Math.atan2(dx, -dz); const da = Math.abs(Math.atan2(Math.sin(b - ob), Math.cos(b - ob))); if (da < 0.44) n++; if (da < 0.44 && c.age01 > 0.2) nn++; } out.push([d, hh ? 17 : 15, n, nn]); } } v.state.simTime = t0; out.sort((a, b) => b[3] - a[3]); return 'heading ' + v.state.heading.toFixed(0) + ' active ' + v.director.active + ' | ' + out.slice(0, 12).map((o) => '7/1+' + o[0] + 'd ' + o[1] + '时 ' + o[2] + '/' + o[3]).join('; ');
